Midwife scam

By: Tarryn Crossman | Production

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
Anchen says she is a pharmacist who can do sonographs. She then tells the parents that they can see her for anti-natal care during the pregnancy and she will then refer them to a midwife for delivery. But they aren’t given direct access to the midwife.

Summary:
Scams we have case studies for

Fake pregnancy
Chiara and Corlia both did scan with her and she told both them they were pregnant and that they should do weekly scans. At around 14/17 weeks they both went for second opinions only to find out that they were never pregnant and the scans were not of a baby at all

Scammed midwives of money
She takes on the patients and says that she will do their checkups until 36 weeks and then she will hand them over to a midwife. The patients pay her in full and she never pays the midwife in full

Scammed mom
Angelique - she got a lawyer and was eventually paid back

Aimz - she scanned the babies stomach instead of its head and said that it was too big to deliver naturally so she must go to state. She went to state and they said baby was find, go natural. So she got another midwife who checked the scans and told her what Anchen had done.
She has not reimbursed her

All paid her in full for the delivery of their babies, but in their final trimester she tells them that they have to go to a state hospital to deliver via C-section and then doesn't pay them back their money

Scammed Midwives
Erna and Ruth
Neither have been paid for the deliveries they did for her
Ruth is currently delivering a baby for free, as the mom paid Anchen in full but Anchen has not paid Ruth. But she can't just let the patient down

Press Release:


Unsound Ultrasound

For mothers-to-be on a budget, the services of a woman offering home-based ultrasounds came as a godsend. But Carte Blanche investigates the tragedy behind claims that the supposed sonographer perpetrated nothing more than a scam. The clients claim she spotted babies where there were none, and even scanned the wrong organs. They say she left them out of pocket, heartbroken and without the actual pregnancies she claimed to have seen on her ultrasound scans.

Producer: Tarryn Crossman | Presenter: Masa Kekana

Script:


Erna
when I ask her where she comes from or what she does? She says she's a pharmacist, apparently, and her son had a baby, that something went wrong
And that's when she's decided she's going to start doing sonars for people

Chiara
She seemed very nice. SHE DID THE SONAR She had the machine. Everything was set up

Voice over:
According to Chiara Petrella when she met Anchen Visser in June last year said she was a sonographer offering mobile ultrasounds and she did a diagnostic scan on her to see if she was pregnant.

Chiara
She said to me you're four weeks and seven days pregnant. So I said to her, But are you sure?. One hundred percent sure. Yes, I'm one hundred percent sure.

Video of Anchen

Masa and Chiara
In that moment, when Antion tells you that you are actually pregnant, how did you feel?
I was overjoyed.
And I went to the shop and I bought Dummies and I made a box and I put the sonar picture in the box with it said The butterflies you used to give me turn into two little feet. And I gave that to my boyfriend.

Voice over
In march 2019 when Corlia Venter did a pregnancy test the last thing she expected was a faint double line. She already has two boys and her husband had had a vasectomy 3 years earlier.

Corlia
So then I found Anshan through a Facebook post.
And she did the scan. And she says, no, but there's a little baby and you're about 11 weeks along and I said are you sure

Scan verité on the steps
This is her scan ….

After that, we went home with the picture. My husband said something didn't look right.. For example, he couldn't see a heartbeat.
And I said, no, there was a heartbeat. He says, no, something didn't look right

Voice over:
As her pregnancy progressed Chiara decided to go to a doctor to make sure that her baby was okay.

Chiara
She did my sonar and she said to me, I'm sorry, but you're not pregnant. There's no sign of pregnancy at all.
Masa
Sho, Ciara...
Chiara
I felt like I'd I had a miscarriage. I didn't know what to do with myself, fell into a very bad depression.

Voice over
Diagnostic medical sonographer Dimakatso Mphelo analysed the ultrasounds that visser had done on Chiara

MASA
This is Ciara's ultrasound at four weeks and six days, she was told that this white blob over here is the baby.
MAKI
I see measurements here, but I cannot make out what was being measured
MASA
Let's take a look at the scan from 10 weeks.
What are we seeing here
MAKI
For the first time, I'm seeing something like that looks like a uterus however, it looks empty
And it's behind a structure that has been measured.
MASA
What does that mean when you say it's behind a structure that's been measured?
So she measures anything, she measures anything and give to the patient.
MASA
There's no baby there.

VOICE OVER:
At what was supposed to be 15 weeks of pregnancy Corlia Venter started bleeding. She immediately rushed to the ER assumin that she was having a miscarriage

CORLIA
the nurse said, she can't find anything on the autism. I said to her, but it has to be there. There should be something she said. No, but she couldn't find anything.
And she said, I'm sorry, there's nothing. This is just your normal period. There's nothing. So.
It felt like losing a baby.
I'm sorry.

VOICE OVER:
We called Visser directly to try and set up an on camera interview
Masa and visser ON THE PHONE

VOICE OVER
Following this call Visser declined to speak to us and insisted that we contact her lawyers.
While we waited for them to reply our investigations continued. Caroline Brits says she gave Visser her last R450 for the month to do an ultrasound and confirm that she was pregnant






CAROLINE
She told me that the baby is fourteen weeks and three days old
She showed us the baby’s little spine. “There's the little head.” Then she said that it is a little girl

VOICE OVER
That was almost 4 months ago. Recently she sent her scans to Private Midwife Erna Loedolff asking to know the sex of the baby. Erna was concerned that she couldn’t see a fetus in the scans and offered to cover the costs of Carolines consultation


ERNA
she plans to deliver by Kallaugher or Pretoria West; she must just go and see them still.

Erna:
if she says she's 21 weeks, according to the dates and everything, then we would have seen quite a biggish baby.
there's nothing. We can't see anything.
There's no baby in this uterus.
CAROLINE: But what about the Voice note
Anchen VN - your baby is fine

CAROLINE
I don’t know why people like that should exist. To deceive people.

VOICE OVER
After waiting days with no communication from vissers lawyers we went to her home to get her side of the story
Barking - calling
masa shouting hello

VOICE OVER
After a few minutes Visser sent us a VN asking us to leave her property and that her Lawyer would contact us.They never did.
But Visser eventually sent us an email denying that she ever intentionally tried to scam any of these women, according to her in all the scans she performed the women appeared to be pregnant.She also said that she suggested they all go for a second opinion.

VOICE OVER
In April this year Amy Wide went to Visser for her 6 week ultrasound. After doing a blood test That confirmed her pregnancy

AMY:
She was struggling to find something
And then she told us to look, they will play it. They were playing with each other.

D and Masa
So are there babies there? She says they're twins.
What I'm seeing here, I'm not seeing the uterus. To me, it looks like bowel movement, what we call peristalsis.
So these babies that she sees are playing together here. These are definitely not babies?
No... Pregnancy does not look like that, it just doesn't look like that.
Honestly, if you know what you're doing, you wouldn't tell someone that there is a baby in that image.
It's very clear. It's very clear.

VOICE OVER
According to Anchen when she did this scan she had just completed her short course in sonography and may have made a mistake.
When Amy went for a second opinion and the new sonographer then scanned her actual womb they confirmed that luckily she was having one baby.
Visser hasn’t just allegedly been deceiving her patients, according to Private midwives Erna Loedolff and Ruth Lopes she has also been scamming midwives

ERNA
she said she's Antion and she is a sonographers and that she's going to make me rich. She's got 400 patients on her books And she said she's looking for a space for people to deliver the babies and she does the sonar's.

VOICE OVER
According to Erna, her and Visser had a verbal agreement The patients would pay Visser and then Visser would pay Erna.

ERNA
Then I saw a patient that delivered by me
I kept on asking, right, will you pay the money over to us? We already did the work and everything went well. And every time that you phone as she lies or she's got one other excuse.
So it's now October, it will be two years and I haven't been paid yet by her,

VOICE OVER
Even though it has been two years, Visser says she will now pay Erna back in full by the 1st of July
Ruth did three deliveries with Visser amounting to R15 000, but to date she has only paid her R4500


RUTH
she tells me she has paid the money in from another account
And then, you know, it's going to take a few days to clear. And then A few days pass and then it's not there. So I just stopped

VOICE OVER
In her email to us Visser says that she is aware of what Ruth is owed money and she will pay her in full. Visser also claims that she will no longer be doing ultrasounds after our investigation.

RUTH
she's targeting poor people
So that's the patience that she takes money from. Its somebody that probably wouldn't be able to do anything to her anyway




Promos:
1. An alleged sonographer is conning women into believing they are pregnant and charging them for ultrasounds, until they realise they were never pregnant
2. We investigate the damaging claims against a sonographer who is allegedly conning women into believing they are pregnant and scamming midwives out of money
3. We investigate allegations that a sonographer is fooling women into believing they are pregnant and scamming midwives out of money. Leaving families heart broken and out of pocket
